label: SIMULATION - stipulated admissions DGP; no causal claim

masseng_boundary.used: standalone synthetic demonstration (NOT MASSENG v5 output)
masseng_boundary.note: progression/capacity exist in MASSENG v5; the exam score bar and reserved-quota gates do NOT -- synthetic demonstration only, not a MASSENG v5 output

plain_result: A score bar admits rich pupils at a higher rate (gap 0.547); a reserved quota narrows the gap (0.091) but does NOT flip its sign, so the pre-declared 'quota flips the gap' rule FAILS, and a contest in which richer pupils invest more effort widens it further (0.761). The quota changes who is admitted, not how much anyone learns — this is a rationing demonstration, not an evaluation of any admissions policy.

statistical_frame.estimand: SES admission/completion gap under each gate
statistical_frame.pass_fail: PASS if baseline gap positive, quota flips it, contest widens it
